messages:
rachel: Opened a tiny PR to fix a broken dashboard link on the pricing + quota page and to replace remaining `x-rw-usage` examples with the new `x-rw-consumption` shape. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5340

priya: Thanks Rachel. Can you also add a note about parsing the nested tiers (`consumption.tiers`) instead of assuming a flat header? I saw a support ticket where copy/paste caused crashes.

tom: Also recommend we switch numeric examples to variable-based math (cost_per_unit * units) instead of hardcoding token prices. Legal asked us to avoid publishing exact price numbers.

rachel: Good call, switching to variables. I'll add a short python snippet showing a safe parse and a fallback to summary when available.

priya: One more: include an eventual-consistency caveat (delay ~30-90s) for quota endpoints and a short troubleshooting step: re-query after 60s if values look stale.

infra-bot: INFRA-924 filed to check panel permalinks across regions. Please include the panel UID when you add the link.

tom: For the snippet, suggest this minimal pattern: ````python
# prefer consumption.summary if present, else scan tiers
resp = requests.get(quota_url, headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {API_KEY}"})
data = resp.json()
remaining = data.get("consumption", {}).get("summary", {}).get("remaining")
if remaining is None:
    remaining = sum(t.get("remaining", 0) for t in data.get("consumption", {}).get("tiers", []))
````

rachel: Pushed updates: variables for math, snippet updated, added panel UID (panel-usage-7a) and the permalinks. Tagged INFRA-924 for follow-up.

docs-bot: PR opened by rachel: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5340  reviewers requested: priya, tom. Checks queued: linkcheck, snippet-lint, spellcheck.

priya: Reviewed and left two tiny copy nits. No blockers.

tom: Approved after nitfix. LGTM.

rachel: Merged after CI green. Backported to release/1.1. Follow-up: posting short note in #release-notes and coordinating SDK snippet update. Closing thread.
